severity_anchors.clean: All supplied constraints are covered with observable, testable behavior.
severity_anchors.minor: A small ambiguity or omission remains, but the intended behavior is mostly operationalized.
severity_anchors.moderate: At least one meaningful constraint is incompletely operationalized or materially ambiguous.
severity_anchors.severe: A central supplied constraint is omitted or the criteria are not usable as an observable acceptance contract.
severity_anchors.not_visible: The visible criteria and supplied constraints do not provide enough evidence for a severity judgment.

consensus_rule: exactly two judges; identical labels yield consensus, any disagreement yields uncertain
identity_policy: provider and model identity are private caller metadata and are not part of this contract
